gaps.problem: ART/EAC is not independently identified with felt trying.
gaps.counterexample: deliberate/reflex twins share the selected profile
gaps.fixed: The note names only an organizational coordinate and conditional experience-internal counterpart.
gaps.open_premise: independent phenomenal interpretation or a further actual organizational discriminator

gaps.problem: Cross-context transfer can be mimicked by hidden common input or off-target perturbation.
gaps.counterexample: two copied registers driven by an unmodelled common calibrator
gaps.fixed: Finite theorem explicitly assumes fixed paths and no hidden common input.
gaps.open_premise: actual intervention fidelity and route evidence

gaps.problem: No actual human, prosthetic user or artificial agent P/I/K instance is established.
gaps.counterexample: analyst-assigned equal-valued traces without common physical membership
gaps.fixed: Toy P/I/K and human/application scopes are separated.
gaps.open_premise: independent physical admission of bearer, carrier and consumer paths

gaps.problem: The finite signature omits wider organization that may distinguish or confound reflex, deliberate action and trying.
gaps.counterexample: two completions of the same finite view with different wider histories or policies
gaps.fixed: No finite-view equality is promoted to complete-organization equality.
gaps.open_premise: ontic completeness or bounded application claim

gaps.problem: No raw human/animal/model dataset was reanalysed and cited studies do not instantiate ART.
gaps.counterexample: agency rating effects can arise from visual goal match without verified common action-reference trace
gaps.fixed: Sources are used only to constrain shortcuts.
gaps.open_premise: predeclared source-specific application with actual paths

impact: editable source ledgers and future paper
gaps.counterexample: PLOS author list names Evans, Gale, Schurger and Blanke
gaps.fixed: R182 and downstream editable records use the corrected authors; frozen R181 history is retained.
gaps.open_premise: future compilation must not import the old attribution
